profile.headline: Software Engineer Expanding into Hands-On, Mission-Driven Work | Sports, Events & Conservation
profile.summary:
I’m a problem solver who likes figuring out how complicated things work, bringing people and information together, and turning ideas into something useful.

I spent almost a decade at PayPal, where I worked as a software engineer on large-scale systems involving data, payments, reporting, and pricing. Over time, I realized that the parts of my work I enjoyed most weren’t necessarily tied to software: troubleshooting difficult problems, organizing complex projects, collaborating across teams, mentoring others, and making information easier to understand.

More recently, I’ve been exploring where those skills can take me outside of a traditional tech career. That has included conservation and GIS work with The Living Desert, native plant and community projects in Palm Springs, and live sports and event operations through the BNP Paribas Open and FIFA World Cup.

I’m especially interested in work that gets me closer to the action -- whether that means working behind the scenes at a major sporting event, using data and GIS to understand the natural world, coordinating a community project, or learning something completely new. I bring a technical brain, a lot of curiosity, strong attention to detail, and a willingness to jump in and help wherever I’m useful.

positions.title: Career transition
positions.description:
Using this period to intentionally explore hands-on, mission-driven work outside of traditional corporate technology while continuing my education and building practical experience.

Continuing coursework in GIS, natural resources, horticulture, and environmental sciences through my local community college, alongside hands-on volunteering with local conservation and land organizations.

Leading my HOA’s native landscape initiative, planning and implementing five new native pollinator gardens while coordinating volunteers, vendors, budgets, and community outreach.

Also gaining experience in live sports and event operations through volunteer and contract work with organizations including the BNP Paribas Open and FIFA World Cup.

positions.title: Owner / Artist
positions.description:
I started painting in the pandemic as something to occupy my time away from screens since my day-to-day work was constant computer time. I was fascinated with the vulnerability and intimacy of body portraiture, with the end goal of getting my muse to see themselves as I did. Where every roll, dimple, stretch mark, and scar told a beautiful story of their experience with the world. Everyone is beautiful in their own ways. 

Beginning primarily with watercolor and acrylic paintings, I ventured into many different art mediums over the years: tattoo, embroidery, crochet, knit, sewing, large form, dance, mixed media, botanicals, collage, linocut, beadwork, engraving, landscape design... I revel in the beginner mindset and using recycled materials whenever I can.

Lately I have focused more on two slower forms of art: slow fashion and sewing my own clothes, pattern making, and tattooing fabric; garden architecture and native plants, flower pressing, and rain harvesting.

No matter the medium, my art has always been about getting people to recognize the endless beauty in natural forms -- whether that's their own body or the landscapes that allow us to be here.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Don't you just love it when, simply because you're a girl, people assume you shouldn't, for example, enjoy math - much less be good at it? Or that they should beat you in certain sports because they're boys? Or that you shouldn't even attempt to do something like replacing a heating element in a dryer? (Yes, speaking from experience.)

Our mission is to encourage and empower girls to pursue educations and careers confidently in Science, Technology, Engineering, Athletics, and Mathematics (full STEAM ahead)! By embracing a girl’s intelligence, education, strength, endurance, imagination, and athleticism, we can normalize being recognized as equal, capable counterparts to men, one day resulting in pay-scale parity and equitable advancement opportunities.

A T-shirt, really?

Buying a t-shirt may seem like an insignificant step in changing the world. We know, however, that small steps can lead to sizable strides; sizable strides can lead to gigantic leaps! Maybe, just maybe, a young girl will see our t-shirts and become inspired to pursue a path she never considered attainable! Perhaps with all of these newly inspired girls excited about Science, Technology, Engineering, Athletics, and Mathematics, it will be a #GirlsNewNormal to see girl engineers, programmers, sports announcers, umpires, hockey players, physicists, statisticians or CEOs. More importantly, whichever path a girl chooses, she will be compensated and treated with the same respect as her male peers.

100% of the profits from the GIRL POWER tee will go toward a scholarship fund to assist girls and minorities in reaching their academic, athletic, and career goals.

volunteerExperiences.role: Board Member, Chairperson of the Landscape Committee

- Designed, presented, and currently leading a multi-year native landscape initiative to transition nearly 10 acres of shared community land into a pollinator paradise in order to improve the local environment, decrease water use and maintenance costs, and get the 79-homes enthusiastic for the change. This includes coordinating contractors and volunteers, creating and managing surveys, databases, and maps, developing budgets, and hosting workshops.
- Facilitate monthly committee meetings, present updates at every board meeting, and regularly communicate with homeowners via newsletters and surveys to build consensus around community improvements.
- Authored formal proposals, including multiple projects receiving unanimous board approval, while identifying creative funding opportunities to maximize project impact.

- Tend to the existing landscape of the preserves which includes pulling weeds, watering, fencing, painting infrastructure, and mowing.
- Nursery work to continue reintegration of native plant species: seed harvesting, cleaning, and storage; watering; tending to greenhouse and lath house juvenile plants; planting in the preserve; soil mixing; propagation; pest management; composting

projects.title: TinderBot
projects.description:
Created a bot to navigate a Tinder profile which included three key features:

1. Swiping on a user-defined number of people
2. Congregating all matches the user doesn't have a message history with
3. Generating possible intro messages the user can send using Markov chains.

projects.title: MpathY
projects.description:
MpathY is a project from the Hacking for Humanity 24-hour hackathon. The purpose of this app is to give victims of situations where they can't trust someone close to them -- the prototype was aimed towards victims of domestic abuse. 

Initially, the app has a facade of a mindfulness, meditation timer but upon entering a code (or touch ID) the user will be directed to a master list of resources they would find useful such as safe houses and national and local hotlines. 

While we were unable to implement all the possibilities within the 24-hour time period, we thought it could eventually be a form of social media and a place where people in similar circumstances can connect and share their stories so they know they aren't alone.

- Designed, presented, and currently leading a multi-year native landscape initiative to transition nearly 10 acres of shared community land into a pollinator paradise in order to improve the local environment, decrease water use and maintenance costs, and get the 79-homes enthusiastic for the change. This includes coordinating contractors and volunteers, creating and managing surveys, databases, and maps, developing budgets, and hosting workshops.
- Facilitate monthly committee meetings, present updates at every board meeting, and regularly communicate with homeowners via newsletters and surveys to build consensus around community improvements.
- Authored formal proposals, including multiple projects receiving unanimous board approval, while identifying creative funding opportunities to maximize project impact.
- Frequently resolve competing priorities among homeowners, contractors, and board members by emphasizing collaboration, transparency, and practical solutions.

- Assist in land stewardship around the Coachella Valley.
- Tend to the existing landscape of the preserves which includes pulling weeds, watering, fencing, painting infrastructure, and mowing.
- Nursery work to continue reintegration of native plant species: seed harvesting, cleaning, and storage; watering; tending to greenhouse and lath house juvenile plants; planting in the preserve; soil mixing; propagation; pest management; composting
